Load Libraries
```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
library(Seurat)
library(ggplot2)
library(clustree)
```

Get Files and Sample Names
```{r}
files = list.files("inserthere", pattern = ".h5", full = TRUE)
samples = sapply(strsplit(files, split = ""),function(x)x[3])
```

Load in Data
```{r}
for(i in 1:length(samples)){
 sample = samples[i]
 file = files[i]
 print(sample)
 td = Read10X_h5(file)
 t = CreateSeuratObject(counts = td, project=sample)
 if(sample == samples[1]){
 obj = t
 }else{
 obj = merge(obj, t)
 }
}
```
